verdict.rationale: Logseq documents an opt-in local HTTP API server for external access to the graph. It uses bearer-token auth, worked curl examples, CORS support and a single POST /api endpoint that dispatches any plugin-API method, so an AI agent can programmatically drive the app. The logseq:// protocol adds a smaller set of invocable actions. Missing for 10: the server is local-only (desktop app must be running), the method reference is community-driven plugin docs, there is no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or versioning policy, and no independent hands-on corroboration.
